description: This file is a shell script intended to configure packet steering and receive packet steering (RPS) settings for network interfaces on an OpenWRT system. It assigns IRQ CPU affinity and configures CPU masks for network device queues based on system topology and configuration settings.

methods.name: find_irq_cpu
methods.description: Determines the CPU core associated with a given network device IRQ by parsing /proc/interrupts and matching device name.

methods.name: set_hex_val
methods.description: Sets a hexadecimal value to a specified file, which is used to configure CPU affinity for network device queues.
